title: The Cauchy dual subnormality problem in two variables
summary: The Cauchy dual subnormality problem asks whether the Cauchy dual of a $2$-isometry is subnormal. This problem has attracted considerable attention due to its connections with moment theory, operator theory, and complex function theory. In particular, it has been closely related to operator-theoretic models on function spaces such as de Branges--Rovnyak spaces and Dirichlet-type spaces. In this paper, we investigate the Cauchy dual subnormality problem in the multivariable setting of toral $2$-isometries.
